node.title: Regime-Aware Semantic Windows: Proposal for Mathematical Assessment and Empirical Validation
node.reading:
From field-derived engineering hypotheses to independent mathematical assessment and empirical validation.

This is a proposal for assessment, not a claim of proof, validated performance or cross-domain generality.

Document Status — Field Note · Series: Regime-Aware Systems Tegrity.AI · The Integral Management Society

This note opens a bounded scientific question to a Swiss university partner: whether the semantic-window formulation is internally coherent, experimentally testable, distinct from existing adaptive-window and change-point families, and plausible enough to justify a formal validation programme. Field history is presented as engineering provenance only; it is not offered as mathematical validation of the new formulation. Throughout, proved results, conditional statements and empirical bets are kept separate.
node.readingSummary: From field-derived engineering hypotheses to independent mathematical assessment and empirical validation.

relations: Semantic-window testing could examine when historical product context ceases to be admissible after a material change.
Regime awareness no es forecast ni un remedio general al concept drift. Definir qué cambio invalida qué inferencia antes de medir.
Context qualification can define a research instance, but does not remove the cost of state preparation or establish quantum advantage.
Una ventana semántica no proporciona acceso coherente gratuito ni speedup. Preparación, extracción, actualización y readout forman parte del coste.
The quantitative review line and the assessment proposal should be read as a scoped evaluation route, with participation and acceptance distinguished from demonstrated results.
No se verifica aquí un acuerdo, ejecución o resultado académico actual fuera de lo que declara el documento público.
